label: L-03
title: Index-4 mints revert OnlyDispatcher for the ~11-tx window between cutover step 8 (hook.setDispatcher) and step 10 (replaceDispatcher), and the core has no resume gates, so a halt inside the window leaves index 4 bricked
rootCause: Step 9's new-pooler setters sit between the hook repoint and the dispatcher swap, and the core has no skip-if-done gates (step 0 requires hook.dispatcher == oldPooler).
description: After step 8's setDispatcher lands, BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.onDispatch reverts OnlyDispatcher for the old pooler (hook L109-110). ATokenDispatcherV2.dispatch calls hook.onDispatch unconditionally, so every index-4 mint reverts until step 10 is mined. In between sit setHook plus the step-9 setters: setMinter, setPSM, setMaxTout, setBatchMinter, setBatchDonationSize, setAuthorizedPooler x4 and setNudgeStreamer, about 11 Ledger-signed --slow transactions. The window is inherent to three independent owner contracts. The real hazard is that the core is not resumable. If the broadcast halts anywhere in steps 8-10 (Ledger timeout, gas, nonce), index 4 stays bricked, and re-running _runCutover fails step 0 L297 (hook.dispatcher != oldPooler). Story 103 says 'resume from receipts', but the core has no skip-if-done gates to resume through.

attackPath: 4. Halt in window: re-run fails step 0 'hook not on old pooler'
failureScenario.likelihood: medium for the window; low for an indefinite halt
failureScenario.assumptions: Story 103 uses this core's step order
failureScenario.externalRequirements: A broadcast halt (Ledger timeout, gas, nonce) inside steps 8-10 for the indefinite case

impact: Index-4 mints revert (user keeps USDS, loses gas; no fund loss per ECON Q4) for the window, indefinitely if the run halts inside it.
assetImpact: None; index-4 mints revert OnlyDispatcher (user keeps USDS, loses gas) for ~11 txs, indefinitely if the broadcast halts in steps 8-10.

exactReverts: re-run after halt: 'UniPoolerCutoverCore: hook not on old pooler'

recommendation: Move step 9's configuration before step 8 (it touches only the new pooler) so steps 8-10 are three consecutive transactions. Give story 103 per-step idempotent gates (as StableStakerCutoverCore did after L-02 2c82d65e65e1), or disable index 4 in NFTMinterV2 across the window.

classification.justification: Fork-proven (test_CODE003_mintRevertsBetweenStep8And10). Availability impact is temporary and fail-closed, with no value at risk. The owner can finish by hand with the remaining onlyOwner calls (replaceDispatcher), so it is not Medium. It is in scope as a footgun because story 103 promises 'resume from receipts' and the core has no gates to resume through (Law-2 facet). Reordering step 9 ahead of step 8 is a cheap fix with a direct precedent (L-02 2c82d65e65e1 gates, fixed). Low.
